newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Old Mutual sees inflation down in 1997.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Old Mutual sees inflation down in 1997.

text.p: South Africa's biggest life insurer Old Mutual on Thursday predicted inflation would drop from a year-on-year rise of 9.4 percent in January to 7.5 percent by the end of the year.

"Although the 9.4 pct rise (in January) was at the upper end of our forecast, inflation will still average around nine percent for the year. The 1997 year-end rate is likely to be around 7.5 percent," said Old Mutual Asset Managers economist Johan Els.
The January inflation figure -- released earlier on Thursday -- matched the December 1996 rate, but was higher than analysts' expectation of a 9.2 percent year-on-year rise.
The month-on-month rise was 1.3 percent from 1.0 percent in December. --- Cape Town newsroom +27-21 4032502
